result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' card title is clipped at its last character. Partially visible carousel items and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport are expected and not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' card, the restaurant title renders as 'Tokumaru Rameı'. The final 'n' is cut off, leaving only a partial stroke, even though there is plenty of horizontal space before the rating. The text container appears to have a fixed width or overflow clipping that is slightly too narrow for the text.
issues.suggestion: Let the title's text container size to its content (flex: 1 with min-width: 0, no hard width). Use proper ellipsis truncation only when the title actually exceeds the space available before the rating. Check that no overflow: hidden or incorrect letter-spacing or width calculation is cutting off the last glyph.
